english: NASA is now going to put the telescope right, so it will send up four astronauts to repair it.
text: put the telescope right 是把故障修好，不是把望远镜向右转。说纠正问题可用 put something right；要说向右转才用 turn right。这里再用 so 把修复打算与派人这一行动连接起来。
